architecture: Sparse original 168x4 MLP, 196 inputs per branch, 134074 parameters
gradient: Per-example CE derivative g=(softmax(logits)-onehot(y))@W; closed-form equivalent of local hidden gradient, uses current linear ten-class head
surrogate: 1.5*CE + .5 mean(g*delta); residual probabilities stopped, W and delta differentiated. Quadratic adds .25 mean(curvature*delta^2), with curvature Var_p(W_i). This includes base CE and head-weight gradients unlike a stopped-g-only branch surrogate.
feedback: Estimated absolute substitution CE = current per-example CE + g*delta (+ .5 curvature*delta² for quadratic); EMA .95 unchanged
hybrids: Exact objective+feedback every 5/10 global training batches, first batch exact; linear surrogate+feedback otherwise; no inverse-frequency loss scaling
selection: Pick approximate arm by aggregate final validation magnitude-soft accuracy; official tests only exact baseline and selected approximate arm
timing: Training-step wall time including branch feedback, excludes diagnostics and evaluation; CPU two threads. Exact baseline currently computes unused Taylor terms as well; separate clean benchmark will address overhead.
limits: Closed-form gradients/curvature for final linear classifier; deeper layers require local backprop gradients and curvature approximations. All branch responses still computed. Fixed training recipe; no replay, pretraining, task ID or saved routes in image-only inference.
